svc.gis.title: Geographic information system (GIS) services
svc.gis.sub.gis-analysis.label: GIS analysis
svc.gis.sub.gis-analysis.desc: Our GIS analysis services turn data into a strategic tool, letting you see the spatial relationships and patterns that stay invisible in tables and text.
svc.gis.sub.gis-analysis.item.1.t: Siting of infrastructure with urban-planning constraints applied.
svc.gis.sub.gis-analysis.item.2.t: Optimising delivery routes and cutting costs.
svc.gis.sub.gis-analysis.item.3.t: Urban planning and cadastral data management.
svc.gis.sub.remote-sensing.label: Remote sensing (RS)
svc.gis.sub.remote-sensing.desc: Remote sensing solutions make it possible to monitor large areas dynamically, without a physical presence on site and without the logistics costs.
svc.gis.sub.remote-sensing.item.0.t: Remote assessment of plant health and growth rates.
svc.gis.sub.remote-sensing.item.1.t: Analysis of snow-cover dynamics in selected areas.
svc.gis.sub.remote-sensing.item.4.t: Mapping the consequences of floods and landslides.
svc.hydro.title: Water resources and hydrological services
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.label: Hydrological studies
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.desc: We carry out high-accuracy hydrological modelling of catchments and river flows, using software packages that meet international standards.
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.item.0.t: Flow assessment and optimisation for hydropower plants.
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.item.1.t: Allocation of drinking- and irrigation-water resources.
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.item.2.t: Complete hydrological studies for hydro-engineering projects.
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.item.3.t: Planning irrigation systems according to the terrain.
svc.hydro.sub.hydro-modeling.item.4.t: The impact of climate change on the water sector.
svc.hydro.sub.water-mgmt.label: Flood modelling
svc.hydro.sub.water-mgmt.desc: We carry out 1D/2D hydraulic modelling of flood risk, based on high-resolution topographic data (DEM/DTM) and rainfall-intensity scenarios.
svc.hydro.sub.water-mgmt.item.0.t: Assessing the probability and severity of floods.
svc.hydro.sub.water-mgmt.item.2.t: Modelling how floods form in the urban environment.
svc.hydro.sub.water-mgmt.item.3.t: Assessing infrastructure made vulnerable by water-related disasters.

svc.edu.sub.gis-edu.label: GIS courses
svc.edu.sub.gis-edu.desc: We run specialised courses in QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, HEC-RAS and Google Earth Engine, from beginners to experienced professionals.
svc.edu.sub.gis-edu.item.0.t: Working with real projects and databases.
svc.edu.sub.gis-edu.item.1.t: Studying leading GIS and hydrological software packages.
svc.edu.sub.gis-edu.item.2.t: Producing final maps, both web and static.

prj.sarnaghbyur-reservoir.title: Hydrological study of the Sarnaghbyur reservoir catchment
prj.sarnaghbyur-reservoir.desc: As part of the project, the hydrological elements of the reservoir's catchment were analysed. The dependability of the mean flow and of maximum discharges was calculated to both the SNiP and the ICOLD standard. Rainfall–runoff modelling was carried out. The minimum discharge and the possible climate impacts were assessed by scenario.
prj.sevaberd-reservoir.title: Hydrological study of the Sevaberd reservoir catchment
prj.sevaberd-reservoir.desc: As part of the project, the hydrological elements of the reservoir's catchment were analysed. The dependability of the mean flow and of maximum discharges was calculated to both the SNiP and the ICOLD standard. Rainfall–runoff modelling was carried out. The minimum discharge and the possible climate impacts were assessed by scenario.
prj.urut-wwtp-flood-risk.title: Flood risk assessment for the Urut wastewater treatment plant
prj.urut-wwtp-flood-risk.desc: For the wastewater treatment plant to be built on the bank of the Urut river for the settlement of Urut, modelling was carried out to assess the risk of the plant being flooded when the river's maximum discharges pass. Using a digital elevation model and maximum-discharge input data, HEC-RAS was used to model the possible water levels at different dependability values.
prj.kamertoon-flood-risk.title: Flood risk assessment for the Kamertoon multifunctional complex
prj.kamertoon-flood-risk.desc: To obtain BREEAM certification, the Kamertoon multifunctional complex commissioned a flood risk assessment. We studied the site, identified the possible sources of flooding and carried out the modelling.
prj.anpp-debris-flow.title: Analysis of the impact of a possible debris flow on the safety of the Armenian Nuclear Power Plant
prj.anpp-debris-flow.client: Scientific and Technical Center for Nuclear and Radiation Safety CJSC
prj.anpp-debris-flow.desc: Existing topographic materials were studied and digitised. Using a rainfall–runoff model, the possible maximum discharges in the delineated catchment were estimated.
prj.yerevan-climate-risk.title: Assessment of climate risks and vulnerability for the city of Yerevan
prj.yerevan-climate-risk.client: ADVISE Business and Legal Consulting LLC
prj.yerevan-climate-risk.desc: As part of the project, the current state of Yerevan's water resources was assessed and climate risks were analysed.
prj.sevan-vision-roadmap.title: Developing a vision roadmap for Lake Sevan
prj.sevan-vision-roadmap.client: ADVISE Business and Legal Consulting LLC
prj.sevan-vision-roadmap.desc: As part of the project, issues related to hydrology and water resources were studied and a vision was developed.
prj.irrigation-demand-automation.title: Automating the calculation of irrigation water demand in a pilot area
prj.irrigation-demand-automation.client: Innovative Solutions and Technologies Center (ISTC) Foundation
prj.irrigation-demand-automation.desc: As part of the project, the calculation of irrigation water demand for a pilot area was automated in a GIS environment. The total irrigation demand was calculated from the parcel area, the crop type and network losses.
prj.stepanavan-landfill-siting.title: Landfill siting study for the communities of Stepanavan, Lori Berd and Gyulagarak
prj.stepanavan-landfill-siting.desc: As part of the project, the volume of the existing landfill in Stepanavan community was estimated. Armenian urban-planning and environmental legislation was applied to select a site for a new landfill: the legal criteria were implemented in a GIS environment and a spatial analysis was carried out.
prj.arable-land-web-map.title: Creating an online map of arable land for an agricultural programme
prj.arable-land-web-map.client: Environmental Projects Implementation Unit, Ministry of Environment of RA
prj.arable-land-web-map.desc: As part of the project, an online map of arable land in the target communities was created, showing the scale of the measures carried out on each arable parcel.
prj.beech-distribution-ecocrop.title: Modelling the link between the distribution limits of beech in Armenia and climate indicators with GIS and EcoCrop models
prj.beech-distribution-ecocrop.client: A. Takhtajyan Institute of Botany, NAS RA
prj.beech-distribution-ecocrop.desc: As part of the project, the climatic conditions of the north-eastern regions of Armenia were analysed and the spatial distribution of precipitation and temperature was produced. Using the EcoCrop model, the growth conditions of beech were modelled under the 2100 climate scenario.
prj.eia-center-training.title: GIS training for the staff of the Environmental Impact Expertise Center of the Ministry of Environment of RA
prj.eia-center-training.client: Environmental Impact Expertise Center, Ministry of Environment of RA
prj.eia-center-training.desc: The course is designed for specialists who want to master the QGIS software package for the purposes of environmental impact assessment.
prj.volios-training.title: GIS training for the staff of Volios Design Institute CJSC
prj.volios-training.desc: Staff training for digitising the infrastructure of Electric Networks of Armenia and managing spatial data.
prj.hetq-media-factory.title: Hetq Media Factory — Data journalism
prj.hetq-media-factory.desc: The first attempt in Armenia to apply GIS in journalism. The students carried out many investigations based on spatial analysis.
prj.flood-information-platform.title: Flood information platform of Armenia
prj.flood-information-platform.desc: The platform is our own idea and initiative. It collects videos about floods that users publish on different social platforms.
